# Dr. Preksha's Aesthetics & Wellness

> Doctor-led skin, hair, laser and permanent makeup (PMU) clinic near Vaishnodevi Circle, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Every treatment starts with a skin consultation with Dr. Preksha; plans are personalised and delivered as a course of sessions. Rated 5.0 on Google.

## Key facts
- Address: Ground Floor, Shivanta Rigel, Vaishnodevi Ring Road (SP Ring Road), near The Hotel Hillock, Tragad, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382421
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 77175 67426
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 10:00–20:00; Sunday 11:00–20:00 (may vary on festivals)
- Treats: women and men
- Also sees patients in: Chandigarh
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aestheticsbydrpreksha_/

## Treatments offered
- Laser hair reduction (face and body)
- Pigmentation and melasma treatment; chemical peels; skin rejuvenation
- Acne scar treatment and microneedling
- HydraFacial and glow treatments
- Q-switch laser; CO2 laser (including mole and skin-tag removal)
- PRP and GFC hair therapy for hair fall
- Permanent brows (microblading) and lip pigmentation treatment
- Anti-ageing treatments; male skin care
- Prices depend on treatment, area and number of sessions; a quote is given after consultation.
